title: GenNA: Conditional generation of nucleotide sequences guided by natural-language annotations

extracted_models.title: GenNA: Conditional generation of nucleotide sequences guided by natural-language annotations

input_routes.route_label: RefSeq GenBank corpus to multimodal pretraining samples
input_routes.source_object_verbatim: GenBank-formatted genomic DNA and RNA annotation files for eukaryotic species from the NCBI RefSeq database
transformation_chain_verbatim: parsed GenBank records automatically with Biopython
extracted molecule type, source species, gene name, and natural-language functional descriptions from the product and note fields
organized hierarchical structures such as mRNA, CDS, ncRNA, and regulatory elements using custom XML-style tags
restricted the corpus to gene-associated regions with explicit annotations
randomly extended the target annotated segment by 0-100 bp upstream and downstream
concatenated multiple samples into long input sequences during sequence packing
input_routes.model_visible_form_verbatim: unified training samples in a shared cross-modal token space
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: custom cross-modal BPE tokenizer feeding a decoder-only Transformer
input_routes.evidence_quote: we collected all available GenBank-formatted genomic DNA and RNA annotation files for eukaryotic species from the NCBI RefSeq database

input_routes.route_label: Real gene sample to sequence-function consistency evaluation
input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: sequence-function semantic consistency evaluation with matched and mismatched annotations
transformation_chain_verbatim: held the underlying nucleotide sequence fixed
systematically replaced the functional-annotation component of the prompt
formed matched and mismatched sequence-function pairings
computed conditional perplexity for each pairing
input_routes.model_visible_form_verbatim: a prompt combining the nucleotide sequence and a functional annotation
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: functional annotation is inserted as a prompt prefix alongside the fixed sequence
input_routes.evidence_quote: the functional-annotation component of the prompt was systematically replaced

input_routes.route_label: Species-labeled sequence prompts to embedding analysis
input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: model embedding and phylogenetic representation analysis
transformation_chain_verbatim: used standardized prompts of the form Genomic DNA or RNA plus species name and <seq>
captured hidden states from layer 18 of the 36-layer Transformer decoder
applied mean pooling across the sequence dimension
visualized embeddings with t-SNE
input_routes.model_visible_form_verbatim: Genomic DNA, [Species Name]<seq> or RNA, [Species Name]<seq>
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: species label is placed in the decoder-only prefix prompt
input_routes.evidence_quote: we used standardized prompts of the form 'Genomic DNA, [Species Name]<seq>' or 'RNA, [Species Name]<seq>'
input_routes.section_heading: Model embedding and phylogenetic representation analysis

input_routes.route_label: Species-swap prompt to phylogenetic PPL perturbation
input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: species-label perturbation analysis using pairwise PPL matrix
transformation_chain_verbatim: replaced the species label in the prompt with that of another species
kept the rest of the input unchanged
evaluated the target sequence under the substituted species prompt
constructed a 10 by 10 PPL matrix
applied hierarchical clustering using Ward's minimum-variance method
input_routes.model_visible_form_verbatim: species-substituted conditioning prompt paired with the unchanged target sequence
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: species label is swapped inside the prompt prefix before perplexity evaluation
input_routes.evidence_quote: the species label in the prompt was replaced with that of species
input_routes.section_heading: Model embedding and phylogenetic representation analysis

input_routes.route_label: Validation gene sequence to in silico mutant sequence evaluation
input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: in silico mutation scanning on protein-coding genes
input_routes.source_object_verbatim: protein-coding genes from an independent validation set
transformation_chain_verbatim: randomly selected 100 protein-coding genes with lengths between 200 and 3,000 bp
introduced single-nucleotide substitutions and single-base deletions at each position in the untranslated regions and coding sequence
classified CDS mutations as synonymous, missense, nonsense, stop-loss, and frameshift
quantified the perturbation by perplexity difference between mutant and wild-type sequences
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: conditional perplexity is computed over the full input sequence
input_routes.evidence_quote: we established an in-silico mutation pipeline based on protein-coding genes from the validation set

transformation_chain_verbatim: provided only the modality label as the initial input
autoregressively generated complete metadata fields
generated species, gene name, functional annotation, and the corresponding nucleotide sequence
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: prompt at the beginning of the sequence
input_routes.evidence_quote: the model received only the modality label (Genomic DNA or RNA) as the initial input
input_routes.section_heading: Unconditional self-generation and semantic fidelity analysis

input_routes.route_label: Species prompt to species-specific sequence generation
input_routes.source_object_verbatim: conditioning species from six representative model organisms
transformation_chain_verbatim: prompted the model with one of six representative model organisms
generated nucleotide sequences without an explicit gene-function constraint
evaluated GC-content, GC3, codon usage bias, and amino acid frequency against species-specific references
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: species name is included in the decoder-only prompt prefix
input_routes.evidence_quote: we prompted the model to generate nucleotide sequences from six representative model organisms

input_routes.route_label: tRNA name prompt to tRNA generation
input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: targeted generation experiments for transfer RNAs
input_routes.source_object_verbatim: tRNA prompt categories with different anticodons
transformation_chain_verbatim: constructed inputs using the format Genomic DNA, [tRNA Name]<seq>
generated 500 samples under each prompt condition
evaluated the generated sequences using tRNAscan-SE v2.0
recorded Cove scores and anticodon/isotype annotations
input_routes.evidence_quote: inputs using the format 'Genomic DNA, [tRNA Name]<seq>'

input_routes.route_label: rRNA class prompt to rRNA generation
transformation_chain_verbatim: constructed inputs using the template RNA, [rRNA Name]<seq>
generated 1,000 candidate sequences for each rRNA class
aligned generated sequences to Rfam covariance models using cmsearch from Infernal
compared bit-score distributions with natural reference sets
input_routes.evidence_quote: Inputs were constructed using the template 'RNA, [rRNA Name]<seq>'

input_routes.route_label: Histone class prompt to histone-coding sequence generation
input_routes.source_object_verbatim: histone class prompts for H1, H2A, H2B, H3, and H4
transformation_chain_verbatim: constructed inputs using the template RNA, [histone]<seq>
generated 1,000 candidate RNA sequences for each histone class and sampling setting
translated RNA sequences into amino acid sequences
compared length, molecular weight, pI, amino acid composition, and ProGen2 perplexity
input_routes.evidence_quote: Inputs were constructed using the template 'RNA, [histone]<seq>'

input_routes.task_or_configuration_verbatim: dynamic information-masking strategy during late pretraining
input_routes.source_object_verbatim: multimodal training inputs with species or gene identifiers in the prompt
transformation_chain_verbatim: randomly removed the species identifier or gene identifier in the prompt with probability 0.5
input_routes.insertion_or_fusion_verbatim: prompt prefix with stochastic identifier dropout
input_routes.evidence_quote: species identifier or gene identifier in the prompt was randomly removed with probability 0.5

input_routes.route_label: tRNA prompt to tRNA sequence generation
input_routes.source_object_verbatim: 61 tRNA prompt categories with different anticodon
transformation_chain_verbatim: constructed inputs using the format 'Genomic DNA, [tRNA Name]<seq>'
generated 500 samples under each prompt condition
evaluated the generated sequences using tRNAscan-SE v2.0 with the default eukaryotic setting
input_routes.evidence_quote: For 61 tRNA prompt categories with different anti-codon, we constructed inputs using the format 'Genomic DNA, [tRNA Name]<seq>'

input_routes.route_label: rRNA prompt to rRNA sequence generation
transformation_chain_verbatim: constructed inputs using the template 'RNA, [rRNA Name]<seq>'
generated 1,000 candidate sequences for each rRNA class
aligned the generated sequences to Rfam covariance models using cmsearch from the Infernal suite
input_routes.evidence_quote: Inputs were constructed using the template 'RNA, [rRNA Name]<seq>'

input_routes.source_object_verbatim: histone family prompts specifying H1, H2A, H2B, H3, or H4
transformation_chain_verbatim: constructed inputs using the template 'RNA, [histone]<seq>'
generated 1,000 candidate RNA sequences for each histone class and sampling setting
